10.name: nameable
10.note: Navio's default. Farthest-point over nameable colours, scored on the worst vision type, opened on the familiar ten.

10.name: distinct
10.note: The same search without the naming floor. Further apart, and some of the colours have no common name.

10.name: mokole
10.note: Generated by mokole.com/palette.html, a published 50-colour set.

10.name: category10
10.note: Navio before 0.3.0, and most charts on the web. Ten colours.

10.name: rainbow
10.note: d3.interpolateRainbow sampled at i/n. Cyclical, so it never repeats an endpoint.

10.name: turbo
10.note: d3.interpolateTurbo. Built for sequential data; included because it is the obvious thing to reach for.
